description: Zbiralniki odpadne elektronske in električne opreme v občini Semič is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA SEMIČ. The collection contains data on collectors of waste electronic and electrical equipment (WEEE) in the municipality of Semič. Coverage: OBČINA SEMIČ. The portal shows the English title as "Waste electronic and electrical equipment collectors in the municipality of Semič" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA SEMIČ. Its keywords include električna oprema, elektronska oprema, odpadki, odlagališča, zbiralniki. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
